---
title: "Professional Python Project Companion"
subtitle: "An Opinionated Guide to Professional Python Project Infrastructure"
author: "Denise M. Case, P.E, PhD (licensed in Kansas)"
---

A professional Python project includes more than good source code.
It includes the files, conventions, automation, documentation, and validation
that allow the project to be developed, maintained, and shared reliably.

This companion explains those parts.

It presents one coherent and intentionally opinionated approach to professional
Python project infrastructure.
The particular tools and configurations are chosen for their popularity and longevity,
but like everything, can be expected to evolve.
The engineering concerns of consistency, reproducibility,
validation, collaboration, documentation, and maintenance that they address will remain.

Maintained canonical examples are included and may be
forked, adapted, and evolved for other projects, teams, and organizations.
